title: Nudges
description: Whether the bot sends you a DM saying how many cards wait on you. Off: you only see the queue channel.

title: Nudge hours
description: The hours (in your timezone) the bot may nudge you. A card that arrives outside them waits for the next allowed slot.

title: Nudges per day
description: How many nudges the bot sends you at most in a day, and only while cards wait on you.

title: Your timezone
description: The timezone your nudge hours are in.

title: Tasks in flight
description: How many agent tasks may be open and not merged yet (in progress through approved). The dispatcher starts no new one above it, so PRs never pile up faster than people merge them.

title: Merge approved PRs by itself
description: When true, a PR that passes every check (and has its Human verification boxes ticked) is merged without waiting for you.

title: Split big tasks without asking
description: When true, refine creates a split's sub-tasks at once; otherwise the split proposal waits for your approve.

title: Where you answer agents
description: github: answer on the issue. claude-slack: steer from Claude Code and answer from Slack (new issues refine by themselves, approved PRs merge). Unset means github; gh agentkit sets the related labels and variables.

title: Slack bot cards
description: On top of claude-slack: true makes the workflows post cards through the agentkit Slack bot and accept its button clicks.

title: The Slack bot's GitHub App
description: The slug of the GitHub App the Slack bot sends its events as. The workflows act only on events this App sent. Empty: the kit's own App (when the bot shares it).

validate.hint: must be a GitHub App slug

title: Card channel
description: The Slack channel id (C…) the bot posts cards to.

validate.hint: must be a Slack channel id such as C0123456789

title: Runner for private repos
description: Where jobs run in a private repo (public repos always use GitHub-hosted runners). Unset means ubuntu-latest.

validate.hint: must be a runner label

title: PR target branch
description: The branch agent PRs target. Empty means the repo's default branch.

validate.hint: must be a branch name

title: Project board number
description: The GitHub Project whose Stage and Rank fields the kit keeps in step. Set by gh agentkit setup; empty means no board.

validate.hint: must be a project number

title: agentkit-bot App client id
description: The GitHub App the workflows act as. Set by gh agentkit; change it only when you move to another App.

validate.hint: must be a GitHub App client id

title: Tech debt share
description: The dispatcher takes one debt issue in every N it starts. 0 ranks debt like any other issue.

title: Tech debt label
description: The label that marks an issue as tech debt for the debt share.

validate.hint: must be one label name

title: Claude model
description: The Claude model the agents use. Each job in the caller can set its own.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id such as claude-opus-5-5

title: Extra plugins
description: Extra Claude Code plugins for one job, one NAME@MARKETPLACE per line: agentkit for the kit's pinned ones, or the name in this repo's .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.

validate.hint: must be NAME@MARKETPLACE lines

title: Refine turn limit
description: The most turns the refine agent may take on one issue before it stops.

title: Implement turn limit
description: The most turns the implementer may take in one run before it stops.

title: Review turn limit
description: The most turns each review agent (code, security) may take on one PR.

title: Review rounds before a person
description: How many failed review rounds an agent PR gets before the issue goes to you (status:needs-human).

title: Wait for other CI
description: Minutes after the head commit a check may stay pending or missing before the issue goes to a person.

title: Test suites (monorepo)
description: One integration suite per part of a monorepo, each on its own runner; only suites whose paths changed run. A JSON list of {name, paths, runs-on, run}; empty runs .agentkit/test.sh.

title: Checks from other CI
description: Checks another CI app posts on the commit that the gate waits for. A JSON list of {name, paths}.

title: What the daily digest lists
description: One label|heading per line; each label's open issues become a section of the digest, in this order.
default:
status:needs-info|Needs your answer
status:needs-human|Handed over to you
status:needs-verification|Needs your verification
status:needs-approval|Needs your approval
status:approved|Approved, waiting for your merge
status:blocked|Blocked

validate.hint: must be label|heading lines

title: Days the retro covers
description: How many days the retro counts. Change the retro's cron to match.

title: Retro Discussions category
description: The Discussions category the retro is posted in.

validate.hint: must be one category name

title: Kit version override
description: Load the kit's scripts and plugin from another commit, branch or tag than the one the caller's uses: line pins. Empty means the pinned one.

validate.hint: must be a commit, branch or tag

title: How often the kit checks in
description: When the dispatcher starts new work and the review gate re-checks other CI (UTC cron).

title: Daily digest time
description: When the daily digest of what waits on you is posted (UTC cron).

title: Retro time
description: When the retro runs (UTC cron). Match it to the retro's days.

title: Repos the Slack bot serves
description: The owner/repo allowlist of the Slack bot (comma-separated); it refuses any other repository.

validate.hint: must be owner/repo, comma-separated

title: Slack bot people map
description: Path, inside the bot's container, of the JSON file that maps Slack users to GitHub logins.

validate.hint: must be an absolute path

title: Slack bot's GitHub App client id
description: The client id of the GitHub App the bot mints its short-lived tokens from.

validate.hint: must be a GitHub App client id

title: Where the Slack bot keeps people's settings
description: Path, on a writable volume in the bot's container, of the JSON file with each person's nudge settings and history.

validate.hint: must be an absolute path

title: The kit's GitHub App name, for the board
description: The slug of the GitHub App the kit's workflows post as, so App Home items show the kit's real question. Empty: a generic line.

validate.hint: must be a GitHub App slug

title: The Slack app's id, for nudge links
description: The Slack app id (A…), so a nudge links straight to the bot's Home tab. Empty: the nudge has no link.

validate.hint: must be a Slack app id, A…

title: Implement time limit
description: The longest a implement run (writing the code and its fix rounds) may take, in minutes, before GitHub stops it and it goes to a person.

title: Integration test time limit
description: The longest a run of the project's integration tests (each suite, when suites are set; their default is 60) may take, in minutes, before GitHub stops it and it goes to a person.

title: Review time limit
description: The longest a Claude code or security review may take, in minutes, before GitHub stops it and it goes to a person.

title: Refine time limit
description: The longest a refine run may take, in minutes, before GitHub stops it and it goes to a person.

title: Plan time limit
description: The longest a planning run may take, in minutes, before GitHub stops it and it goes to a person.

title: Planner turns
description: How many turns the planner may take to split a big task.

title: Retro turns
description: How many turns the weekly retro may take to find causes.

title: Implement model
description: The Claude model for writing the code only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Review model
description: The Claude model for the code and security reviews only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Refine model
description: The Claude model for refining new issues only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Plan model
description: The Claude model for splitting big tasks only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Retro model
description: The Claude model for the weekly retro only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Settings model
description: The Claude model for answering settings questions in Slack only. Empty: the project's Claude model.

validate.hint: must be a Claude model id, like claude-sonnet-5-5

title: Merge method
description: How the kit merges an approved PR.

title: Delete merged branches
description: true: the kit deletes an agent's branch once its PR is merged.

title: Retry a failed run once
description: true: a failed implement run (an API or GitHub hiccup) is retried once before it goes to a person; false: it goes to a person at once.

title: Require integration tests
description: true: a PR fails review when the project has no executable test script; false: the check passes with a warning.

title: Test script
description: The project's integration test script, a path inside the repo.

validate.hint: must be a path inside the repo

title: Digest items per section
description: How many issues the daily digest lists under each heading.

title: Retro proposals
description: How many changes the weekly retro may propose at most.
